title: How to Use the La Maison Scheduling Page
subtitle: For La Maison cleaners and property inspectors
end_title: Thank you for taking care of La Maison.

segments.spoken: This video shows La Maison cleaners and inspectors how to use the scheduling page.
Checking a date is not enough. Your name goes on the calendar only after you tap Sign me up.
To start, open your own link in your web browser. Each person gets their own link. You do not need a password.
segments.caption: Open your own link. No password needed.

segments.spoken: The page greets you by name. This video uses a sample person named Sam.
There are five tabs across the top: My dates, Tasks, Supplies, Contractors, and Help.
My dates is where cleaners and inspectors sign up for the days they want to work.
The box near the top lists the three steps to sign up.
Below the steps is one card for each date. A grey card with a lock is already taken.
The card shows who has that date. You cannot pick it.
A card you can pick is white. It has an empty circle on the left.
The word Needed in orange means nobody has that job yet.
Each card shows the date, the hours, who is cleaning, and who is inspecting.
Some cards also say same-day turnover next to the hours.
To pick a date, tap its card. A check mark appears and the card turns green.
Then tap Sign me up at the bottom. This step puts your name on the La Maison calendar.
If you check a date and leave without tapping Sign me up, you are not signed up.
Your name goes on that day's calendar event. The event runs from checkout to check-in.
After you sign up, the page shows a calendar with your dates on it.
If you cannot make a date, uncheck it and tap Sign me up again.
Inspectors use the same page. On an inspector's link, the white cards are dates that still need an inspection.
Next is the Tasks tab. This tab is for property inspectors.
It holds the inspection checklist. Go through the whole list at every inspection, every time.
The list has seventy-six items in thirteen groups, such as Bathroom, Kitchen, and Living Areas.
Tap a group to open it. The numbers on the right show how many items you have finished.
When you finish an item, tap the circle next to it.
Tap Instructions and why it matters to read more about that item.
A finished item gets a check mark and a line through it. The count goes up.
Check off every item, even if the house looked fine last time.
At the bottom, the page shows how many items you have completed.
When you are done, tap Submit inspection. This sends your results to Slack.
If you see a Your name box above the button, type your name first.
The Supplies tab is also for inspectors. Use it when something in the house is running low.
Tap the first box. Pick the item from the list, or type its name.
In the next box, say how much is left. For example, two rolls, or half a bottle.
Then tap Add Item to List. That adds it to the list of things to buy.
The Contractors tab lists La Maison's maintenance vendors.
Use the search box to find a vendor by name, type, phone, or email.
Each card has a Text button and an Email button. Use them to reach that vendor directly.
The Help tab has the sign-up steps in writing. Open it any time you want a reminder.
Thank you for taking care of La Maison.
